folds.heading: ## Investigation-use reconciliation B116, 2026-11-04
folds.body:
Full LA1–LA12, BC1–BC9, DT1–DT7/DX1–DX5, ES1–ES8, SD1–SD6, J1–J3 and report read. Preserve mixed causes and useful action before certainty. Evidence, diagnosis, causal mechanism, culpable intent and legal recognition remain distinct; scoped negative/inconclusive evidence is not universal absence. First witnessed practice is not first-ever practice, familiar marks are not ancestry, and a correction neither erases competence nor automatically reverses a settled transfer. Every tell needs an actual occurrence, witness/channel and known coverage. Copied reports are one source chain; freeze recalled details before comparison, preserve disagreement and corrections, and keep active evidence outside feed pruning.

[EVENT_SHAPES](EVENT_SHAPES.md) is compiler/planning input, not newly admitted effects or a general cast API. Its final storylet-arrival readback supersedes initial absence. A deck selects a delivery opportunity, not body truth, diagnosis, cure or NPC disclosure. Actual means, subject identity, quoted protocol, noisy outcome where supported, care/work consequence and communication need their owners. No random failure for an exact means, truth-specific price/sort leak or timeout autodiagnosis. People/Notebook requires a real provider; writing an arbitrary knowledge key does not create a row. Keep richer evidence admission explicit or use the declared bounded separate-key adapter.

The old one-realm/one-prestige sequencing sentence is history, superseded by current [PROJECT](../../../../../PROJECT.md); human review is optional under AD42 in [RULES_INDEX](../../../../RULES_INDEX.md). The five ranked suggestions are unselected palette, not new priority or a demand to implement every test. Current desktop/laptop direction qualifies fixed 1366 wording. Historical source SHA/locator checks and peer reports do not prove current APIs, served bytes or this pass reading all dependencies. All three journeys remain specified, not played by this review. No source/canon/private-save or runtime verification was added.

folds.heading: ## Diagnostic palette reconciliation B116, 2026-11-04
folds.body: The complete [B13 investigation packet](gm/dispatch/body-lineage-2026-10-14/b13/REPORT.md#investigation-use-reconciliation-b116-2026-11-04) preserves LA/BC investigations and ES/DT/SD delivery designs. Treat clues as observed evidence with actual means and coverage, not hidden-cause labels. Mixed causes, useful care/work before certainty, conflicting claims and independent reference routes remain available; a legal certificate is another consumer. Event delivery, tests, intervention and communication have separate receipts and owners. The former one-prestige sequencing line is retired; these suggested slices do not change current priorities, and AD42 human review remains optional.
